rationale: Consuming available butyrate and propionate (abundant SCFAs) along with branched-chain and aromatic amino acids for both C and N. Fermentation yields acetate, succinate, and CO2. Growth rate supported by 3.3 mmol N/gDW/h uptake (8 mmol N per gDW needed). Carbon balance: 99 mmol in = 16.9 (growth) + 82.1 (products).
